records.text: Owens accused Gerald Morgan Jr. of making a live call from her children's playroom despite an agreement prohibiting filming outside the studio.

appearances.snippet: Gerald (Gerald Morgan) decided to do a live call in from my kid's playroom just outside the studio. ... And it was actually in complete violation to what we agreed to because one thing the contract did stipulate was no filming outside of this studio.

verification.notes: At 14:25 Owens explicitly accused Gerald Morgan Jr. of making a live call from her children's playroom despite the stated filming restriction. This verifies that the accusation was made, as required for an accusation-type statement; the private agreement and exact room boundary were not independently adjudicated.
